title: Predictive learning: NLP
reading: The slide introduces predictive (self-supervised) learning in natural language processing, using masked language modeling as exemplified by BERT. The stated task is to predict the masked words or tokens within a piece of text, so the supervision signal comes from the text itself rather than external labels.

concepts.name: Masked language modeling
concepts.why_it_matters: Defines the pretext task—recovering hidden tokens—that lets models learn language representations without labels.

concepts.name: BERT
concepts.why_it_matters: Canonical model instantiating masked language modeling.
